يغتالون (form VIII)
# يَغْتَالُونَ (yaḡtālūna) /jaɣ.taː.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَالَ (iḡtāla)
# يُغْتَالُونَ (yuḡtālūna) /juɣ.taː.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَالَ (iḡtāla)
